data.title: The Highgrove
data.about:
The Highgrove in MBR City by Ellington Properties introduces a new standard of luxury living, offering a variety of residences, including one to three-bedroom apartments, penthouses, duplexes, and sky villas. Nestled in a prime location near Downtown Dubai and the World Islands, it promises connectivity and exclusivity, making it a sought-after destination for modern living.  

The project boasts exceptional amenities, including a crystal lagoon with sun loungers, an infinity-edge leisure pool, fitness studios, a clubhouse, children’s indoor and outdoor play areas, and a flotation therapy pool. These thoughtfully designed features create an oasis of relaxation amidst Dubai's vibrant energy.  

Ellington’s The Highgrove caters to diverse lifestyles, offering expansive spaces for comfort and elegance. With convenient Highgrove payment plans and proximity to iconic landmarks, the development provides an unmatched opportunity for Mohammed Bin Rashid City property investment. Whether for living or investment, this project offers a lifestyle that is both fulfilling and luxurious in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities.

characteristics_module.title: Where Luxury Meets Nature in the Heart of MBR City
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• It is located in MBR City with easy access to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and The Dubai Mall, offering prime connectivity and exclusivity.  
  • It offers one—to three-bedroom apartments, penthouses, duplexes, and sky villas with biophilic designs that blend nature and modern luxury.  
  • It features premium amenities, including a crystal lagoon, infinity-edge pool, fitness studios, clubhouse, and children’s play areas.  
  • A flexible 70/30 payment plan with a handover in Q4 2027 is ideal for Mohammed Bin Rashid City property investment with high rental yield potential.  
  • Family-friendly community with proximity to prestigious schools like North London Collegiate School.  
  • Includes practical features like EV charging stations, bicycle parking, moving zones, and air-conditioned retail arcades.

location_tile.title: An Investment in Luxury, Lifestyle, and Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: The Highgrove at Meydan in MBR City by Ellington Properties offers an exceptional location for luxury living. This development provides quick access to Business Bay, DIFC, and major roads. Families benefit from prestigious schools nearby, such as North London Collegiate School. Located just 12 minutes from The Dubai Mall, The Highgrove at MBR City ensures residents enjoy seamless access to shopping and entertainment. As part of Meydan real estate projects, it offers a prime Mohammed Bin Rashid City property investment opportunity.
